activities.help: The activities, the rows of the matrix, in display order, each with an id and a name. The id stays the same when renaming and moving; the commands and the roles address an activity by it.

id.help: The id of the activity; value for activityId and first part of the key in assignments.

name.help: The name of the activity, as shown in the first column.

stakeholders.help: The stakeholders, the columns of the matrix, in display order, each with an id and a name. The id stays the same when renaming; the commands and the roles address a stakeholder by it.

id.help: The id of the stakeholder; value for stakeholderId and second part of the key in assignments.

name.help: The name of the stakeholder, as shown in the column header.

assignments.help: The roles that are set, one entry per cell with a role. The key joins the id of the activity and the id of the stakeholder with a colon, such as a1:s2. The value is R (responsible, does the work), A (accountable), C (consulted) or I (informed). A cell without a role has no entry.

warnings.help: The check per activity, only activities with a finding, in row order: no R, no A or more than one A. Without stakeholders every activity has the findings no R and no A; the interface shows the warning symbols only once there are stakeholders.

addActivity.help: Appends an activity, a new row, with the entered name to the matrix and returns its id.

params.text: The name of the activity; surrounding whitespace is dropped. An empty text is rejected.
params.command: The command as one object with text.

addStakeholder.help: Appends a stakeholder, a new column, with the entered name to the matrix and returns its id.

params.text: The name of the stakeholder; surrounding whitespace is dropped. An empty text is rejected.
params.command: The command as one object with text.

renameActivity.help: Renames an activity; id, place and roles stay.

params.activityId: The id of the activity. An unknown id is an error.
params.value: The new name; surrounding whitespace is dropped. An empty name is rejected and leaves the old one in place.
params.command: The command as one object with activityId and value.

renameStakeholder.help: Renames a stakeholder; id, place and roles stay.

params.stakeholderId: The id of the stakeholder. An unknown id is an error.
params.value: The new name; surrounding whitespace is dropped. An empty name is rejected and leaves the old one in place.
params.command: The command as one object with stakeholderId and value.

removeActivity.help: Removes an activity together with its roles; the other rows and their roles stay unchanged.

params.activityId: The id of the activity. An unknown id is an error.
params.command: The command as one object with activityId.

removeStakeholder.help: Removes a stakeholder together with its roles; the other columns and their roles stay unchanged.

params.stakeholderId: The id of the stakeholder. An unknown id is an error.
params.command: The command as one object with stakeholderId.

moveActivity.help: Moves an activity to another place in the order; its roles travel along.

params.activityId: The id of the activity. An unknown id is an error.
params.to: The place the activity has after the move, counted from 0, at most the number of activities minus one. Its current place leaves everything as it is; a place outside is an error.
params.command: The command as one object with activityId and to.

setRole.help: Sets the role of a cell to a specific value.

params.activityId: The id of the activity, the row of the cell. An unknown id is an error.
params.stakeholderId: The id of the stakeholder, the column of the cell. An unknown id is an error.
params.role: The role: R (responsible, does the work), A (accountable), C (consulted) or I (informed). The empty text takes the role back. Any other value is an error.
params.command: The command as one object with activityId, stakeholderId and role.

cycleRole.help: Advances the role of a cell by one step, like a click on the cell: no role to R, R to A, A to C, C to I, I back to no role. R does the work, A is accountable, C is consulted, I is informed. setRole sets a specific value.

params.activityId: The id of the activity, the row of the cell. An unknown id is an error.
params.stakeholderId: The id of the stakeholder, the column of the cell. An unknown id is an error.
params.command: The command as one object with activityId and stakeholderId.

topN.help: How many missing assignments the tile shows at most, from 1 to 20.

showLegend.help: Shows the legend of the roles R, A, C and I with their count below the bar.

RowWarning.activityId: The id of the activity with a finding.
RowWarning.issues: The findings of the row in this order: noR (no R), noA (no A), multiA (more than one A).
